product_overview: Cars-G is a community-driven civic engagement Progressive Web Application (PWA) designed to facilitate real-time incident reporting and management for traffic, infrastructure, and public safety issues. It connects citizens, patrol officers, and administrators to improve response times, increase transparency, and foster community involvement through user-friendly features, gamification, and comprehensive administrative tools.
core_goals: Empower citizens to quickly and accurately report community incidents through an intuitive multi-step interface with AI-powered support.
Provide patrol officers with efficient job assignment, real-time navigation, and progress tracking tools to enhance field operations.
Enable administrators to manage users, oversee reports, verify identifications, communicate announcements, and monitor comprehensive analytics for informed decision-making.
Ensure secure and scalable authentication and authorization systems with role-based permissions and privacy-compliant data handling.
Offer a real-time communication system between users and administrators to foster timely interaction and resolution.
Deliver a high-performance, accessible, and mobile-first platform with PWA capabilities for offline use and push notifications.
Promote community engagement via gamification including achievements, leaderboards, and motivational content.
key_features: Incident Reporting System with multi-step report creation, location mapping via GPS/map/manual entry, image upload (up to 5 files) with AI image analysis for categorization and content moderation.
Real-Time Interactive Dashboard featuring map views with live updates, status-based filtering, clustering, and admin controls for managing report statuses and assignments.
Comprehensive Case Management including ticketing with unique identifiers, priority levels, group assignment, and status workflows from verification to resolution.
Robust User Authentication with email/password, Google OAuth, ID verification workflow, email verification, and JWT-based secure tokens.
Gamification Mechanics including point allocation, achievement badges, experience levels, and leaderboards with trend analytics.
Admin Portal with extensive features such as user management, announcement system with priority and audience targeting, detailed statistics, and export capabilities.
Communication Module enabling real-time one-on-one chats between users and admins via Socket.IO with typing indicators, read receipts, and notifications.
Navigation System integrating OpenStreetMap and Google Maps APIs for accurate geolocation, routing, and waypoint navigation tailored for patrol officers.
Progressive Web App functionality supporting offline mode, push notifications through Firebase Cloud Messaging, service workers, and user install prompts.
Security and Compliance involving encrypted communication, data protection policies, GDPR adherence, comprehensive input validation, and AI-powered content moderation.
user_flow_summary: User registration with email/password or Google OAuth, followed by optional ID verification submission.
Incident report creation through a multi-step wizard: input details, select location, upload images, AI analysis, review, and submit with offline support.
Users browse report listings, access detailed views, and engage via comments, likes, and chat with administrators.
Patrol officers receive assigned jobs on their patrol dashboard, navigate to incident locations, update status, and complete reports with proof.
Administrators access a powerful admin dashboard to manage users, verify IDs, oversee reports, publish announcements, and view analytics.
Real-time chat initiated by users or admins with notifications, typing indicators, and message history.
Gamification elements update dynamically as users gain points, unlock achievements, and appear on leaderboards.
Push notifications alert users on report status changes, new messages, announcements, and achievement unlocks.
Users access profile management to update information, upload avatars, and review personal statistics and achievements.
validation_criteria: All key user roles (User, Patrol, Admin) can only access and perform permitted actions according to RBAC policies.
Incident reports undergo validation for input completeness, character limits, image format/size compliance, and AI-based content moderation.
Real-time updates via WebSocket are tested for accuracy, latency below 3s, and reconnection handling under network fluctuations.
Authentication workflows including registration, login, password reset, and token refresh operate securely and reliably with proper error handling.
Admin management features (user roles, verification queue, announcements) correctly reflect database state with immediate UI updates.
Gamification rewards trigger appropriately upon qualifying user actions, and leaderboard data is consistent and paginated.
Push notifications are delivered on supported devices after permission grants and follow users’ notification preferences.
Performance benchmarks for page load (FCP <1.5s, TTI <3.5s), animation smoothness (60 FPS), and API response times (<3s) are consistently met.
Data security practices are enforced including encrypted storage, privacy compliance, and prevention of common vulnerabilities (XSS, CSRF, SQL injection).
